messages:
clare: Quick partner-preview sync — we need to finalize launch lane and embargo timing. Can we lock the landing hero, press quote, and SI demo window today?
aj: I'll take the hero and quote. pushing draft in 45m. need final CTA from product.
maria: CTA proposed: 'Start a 14-day dedicated trial of Redwood Inference'. ok?
aj: fine by me.
clare: Press team asked for Wed 09:00 PT embargo. SI leads want partner demo window Wed 08:00 PT (short overlap). Risk of screenshots leaking. suggestions?
sam: Recommend partner-demo window 07:30	6:30 PT for internal demos, then partner-preview 08:0010:00 PT with watermark. Staging cutover can be Tue 20:00 PT.
jordan: We still need final HW rack imagery and vendor logo placement; vendor legal is reviewing logo usage.
clare: @legal-bot status on logo TOU?
legal-bot: Legal: vendor logo terms under review. Expect approval Tue 15:00 PT barring redlines. Note: EU trademark clauses may require small tweaks.
maria: Localization needs final strings by Tue 12:00 PT for fr/de/ja. Engineering can turn banners in ~18h after strings.
aj: I'll send final strings to localization by 11:30 PT and ask for expedited turnaround.
clare: SI onboarding quick checklist:
```
- partner tenant provisioned
- anonymized test dataset loaded
- integration runbook updated
- demo scripts validated (hero prompts)
- watermark on partner screenshots
- support rotation assigned
```
clare: Anything missing?
jordan: Add 'HW smoke test' for partner racks (power/thermal).
aj: Add 'landing telemetry check' 	6 consent banner present.
maria: Add 'signed customer blurbs' before publishing. Legal note: customer quotes need written consent.
clare: press-bot, do we have embargo template + distribution list ready?
press-bot: Press: embargo email + distribution list ready. Will attach to PR. Need exec quote by Tue 14:00 PT.
clare: Sam, can you own the cutover runbook + rollback?
sam: I'll draft schedule by EOD. Rollback: snapshot + traffic flip, estimated 12-20m depending on caches. I'll post the runbook link once ready.
jordan: I'll chase partner PMs for logo and rack shots now. If logo delayed, we can ship with partner name text block temporarily.
legal-bot: Note: avoid using partner marks in marketing pixel ads until explicit permission.
maria: I'll email partners for quote approvals and push localization.
aj: Draft hero: "Production-ready LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
clare: Strong. maybe add 'predictable latency and cost controls' as a subhead?
aj: Subhead draft: "Predictable latency, cost controls, and unified tooling for production LLMs."
clare: Approved from product side.
clare: Recap / next steps:
- aj: finalize hero + subhead + CTA by 11:30 PT
- maria: localization + partner consent requests by EOD
- sam: staging cut Tue 20:00 PT, draft rollback/runbook by EOD
- jordan: chase logos + HW images, escalate if no signoff by Tue 15:00 PT
- legal-bot: final review of partner TOU and customer quote permissions by Tue 15:00 PT
- press-bot: embargo template attached, wait for exec quote by Tue 14:00 PT
If all clear, soft staging Tue 20:00 PT, partner-preview Wed morning, press embargo Wed 09:00 PT. Ping this thread with any blockers. :rocket:
